## Summary

Describe the behavior change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests and checks run locally
- [ ] UI behavior checked when applicable
- [ ] Evidence, hashes, or benchmark results updated when applicable

## Research integrity

- [ ] This change does not overstate the controller, dynamics, or biological interpretation.
- [ ] Any new generated evidence distinguishes training, validation, and held-out evaluation.
- [ ] No tokens, private data, or large ignored archives are included.
